answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and the research associate does not belong to it.
The budget planning round is a central unit working round and not the place where the research associate's matters are decided.
The appointment committee handles professorship appointments, which is outside the research associate's assigned body.
The faculty council handles faculty-wide affairs where the research associate does not sit.
The study commission prepares degree programmes and is not the research associate's designated body.
The examination board decides individual examination matters, not applicable to the research associate's place.
The internal research funding round awards grants, but the research associate only takes part in their single assigned place.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions, which is not the research associate's specific place.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a separate matter outside the research associate's delimited participation place.
Orientation week planning is for student onboarding and not the research associate's designated matters.
